title.official: Action to be taken when defendant or respondent added

variants.BOOK_A: Action to beTakenWhen Defendant or Respondent Added

operative_text.controlling:
3.76(1)  If a defendant or respondent is added to or substituted in
an action, the plaintiff, originating applicant, plaintiff-by-
counterclaim or third party plaintiff must, unless the Court
otherwise orders,
(a) amend the commencement document, as required, to
name the new party, and
(b) serve the amended commencement document on each of
the other parties.
(2)  Unless the Court otherwise orders,
(a) in the case of a new defendant, the new defendant has the
same time period to serve a statement of defence as the
defendant had under rule 3.31, and
(b) the action against the new defendant or new respondent,
as the case may be, starts on the date on which the new
party is added to or substituted in the action.

BOOK_A.commentary_review_flag: Read in full, p.3-245 (line 8072) to p.3-245 (line 8076): rule text (in pieces), Defined Terms 'commencement document, Court, defendant, plaintiff, third party plaintiff' and Related Provisions '3.31 (statement of defence)'; Book A prints no Information Note and no note for 3.76. The built record: the text, defined_terms and related_provisions (the Related Provisions line ends with the title of 3.77 and the first lines of 3.77's text, printed at line 8076); nothing dropped except the raw text (text note). (1) Related Provision '3.31 (statement of defence)' agrees with the official title of 3.31 ('Statement of defence') and with 3.76(2)(a). (2) History: footnote 1 (1968 R.39; 1914 R.29; 1944 C.R.62 as amended by Alta.Reg. 35/60; English O.16 r.13, enacted 1925) is 3.76's by the marker '1' after (2)(b); it is printed in the 3.75 record (line 8067). The 3.77 footnote 2 (1968 R.688) is in the same block. (3) Pointers to this rule (searched combined rule3.txt, combined_rule2.txt to combined_rule15.txt, combined rule1.txt, Alberta_Rules_of_Court.txt for '3.76'): Book A's 3.26 Related Provisions (p.3-71, line 1906) '3.76(2)(b) (new parties to action)' (agrees with official 3.76(2)(b): the action against the new defendant starts on the date added); Book A's 3.29 note (p.3-79, line 2166) 'R.3.76(2)(b) ... On the new statutory time for adding parties,'; Book A's 3.74 Related Provisions (line 7535) '3.76(2)(b) (time of adding new parties)' and the 3.74 note (line 7676) 'See C.P.E., Chapter 8, Part E.5 and R.3.76(2)(b)'; no other rule file names 3.76; Book B's 3.74 commentary quotes 3.76(1)-(2) and applies 3.76(1)(b) (Anglin v. Resler 2022 ABCA 362, paras 19-20: 'Rule 3.76 provides that when a defendant is added or substituted, that defendant must be served ...'; 'Based on a strict reading of R. 3.76(1)(b), the respondent could now be ordered to re-serve the appellant ...'); Book B's 3.27 commentary part 3 says that if a new defendant is added the 'R. 3.26 limitation period starts to run again' - compare 3.76(2)(b) (recorded in the 3.27 pass).
